name: fx-tests
description: Command-line access to the Firefox test-health data behind https://tests.firefox.dev/
// bin: dist/fx-tests.js is a committed build artefact. Node refuses to strip types under node_modules, so an installed package cannot run from .ts, and no install hook can build one (npm runs prepare/prepack in a bare clone before devDependencies exist). It lives in dist/ rather than bin/ because npm dropped all of bin/ when packing a git checkout, the gitignored dev entry point taking the bundle with it. `npm test` fails if it is stale.
// files: Only the bundle and the docs ship; the CLI never reads the sources or fixtures at runtime. There is no .npmignore on purpose — npm applies one when preparing a git dependency, which emptied the installed package. Check with `npm pack --dry-run`.
// publishConfig: Not published to npm. `private: true` would block the git-URL install this is distributed by, so accidental publishing is prevented with a registry that refuses the request instead.
// scripts: The bundler task is named `bundle`, not `build`. pacote prepares a git dependency — running `npm install` inside its cache clone — whenever the manifest has a build, prepare, prepack, install, preinstall or postinstall script, and under `npm install -g` that preparation leaves the global package a symlink into `_cacache/tmp/git-clone*`, which is deleted when the install finishes. Renaming the script keeps the git-URL install a plain copy.
